correctness.rationale: The cotangent half-angle coordinate conditioned on Z1 gives independent standard Cauchy B,C,D,E and EXACT ratios (D-B)/(C-B) and (E-B)/(C-B). E_t becomes t|C-B|<m=min(|D-B|,|E-B|); the scaled unnormalised h_t=f(b)f(d)f(e)f(b+y/t)1_{|y|<m} converges pointwise. E min(|D|,|E|)<infinity and f(b)^2(1+|b|) integrability justify finite K. Split |y|<=t|b|/2 vs complement; in complement both independent Cauchy D,E have tails >=t|b|/4 for t>=4, giving vanishing O(1/t) far contribution. Scheffe turns L1 mass convergence into total-variation of the normalized density. One-dimensional Martin cross-ratio tail yields the conditional 1/log t law. Independent numerical quadrature at 96 and 192 nodes gives K≈0.34310358 and 0.34310352 (consistent, not a proof).
